query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_movies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'published' AND content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as published_with_content,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'draft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as still_draft
FROM mcu_media 
WHERE mediaType = 'movie'
